title: lantana aristata
intro: Lantana aristata, commonly known as Yellow Sage, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and treating respiratory issues. The health benefits of Lantana aristata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions. Additionally, the plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and support immune function.
